Description

Packed core per-bank JEDEC windows, in MC (controller) cycles. EVERY JEDEC timing field in this map is a count of MC cycles of COMMAND SPACING: a window programmed to N is enforced as exactly N cycles between the two commands (JEDEC-exact). The bank windows have been exact since MC-003 (2026-10-17); the global windows (tRRD, tCCD, tWTR, tRTW) were enforced as N+1 until memory-controllers BUG-004 (2026-11-18), which pumice TASK-034 had documented and kept. Pinned by proof: formal/mc_common/ {mc_bank_timer,mc_global_timers} forbid opening before N and carry c_*_exact covers that reach N. Program the JEDEC value from the part datasheet (the host's phase margin included); do not add or subtract a cycle for the block.
